(2) The man and woman are seen inside a train car, looking directly into the camera and waving. The woman has short hair and a beige shirt, while the man wears a light t-shirt. Later, the man and toddler are in a bookstore with warm, organized shelves, where the child reaches for a picture book. (3) The scene shifts to the exterior and interior of the Eslite Spectrum store. A staff member stands at the entrance near displays of Taiwanese tea and snacks. The camera then performs a montage of various products including snack bags, frozen dumplings, and bottled juices, showing hands holding or pointing to them. (4) The man is shown holding a shopping basket filled with goods, opening a tin of lozenges and giving a thumbs up. A split-second shot of a roaring lion appears as a comedic insert. The woman is then seen working at a laptop in a different indoor setting, followed by a screen capture of a flight confirmation. (5) The final scene features the trio—man, woman, and child—outdoors at night in a modern urban area. They are smiling and waving at the camera. The lighting comes from surrounding streetlights and building signs, creating a warm and energetic atmosphere for the video's conclusion.
